title: REDEEM’D from death, Redeem’d from sin

lines.text: REDEEM’D from death, Redeem’d from sin
Redeem'd from ills without, within
Redeem'd what new light gilds the skies!
What glories on the soul arise.
Redeem’d Redeem'd my song shall be
Through time and through eternity
Redeem'd! let all the ransom’d sing
Eternal praise-to Christ our King!
Glory to Him, whose love unknown
Touch'd man’s a-byss from heaven's
high throne
Like some new star its radiance beamed.
A new song rose-Redeemed!
As ocean's billows swell and break,
The mighty tide of praise shall wake;
Thy love Lord, like th’unfathomed sea
Shall waft a world redeemed to thee.
Redeemed! creation joyful brings
Its tribute to the King of Kings
Redeemed! earth‘s million voices raise
One sounding anthem to His praise.
